items.title: The cotangent complex of a morphism of schemes restricted to an affine open is the sheafified ring-level complex
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter cotangent.tex (The Cotangent Complex)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file cotangent.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a morphism of schemes f : X -> Y and affine opens U = Spec(B) of X and V = Spec(A) of Y with f(U) contained in V, there is a canonical map from the sheafification of L_{B/A} to the restriction L_{X/Y}|_U which is an isomorphism in D(O_U), compatible with restricting to smaller affine opens (source lines 4129-4140). The proof builds the map in three steps: the canonical map of complexes from the ring-level complex of global sections L_{O_X(U)/f^{-1}O_Y(U)} to L_{X/Y}(U) taken from a chapter remark, then the canonical map L_{B/A} -> L_{O_X(U)/f^{-1}O_Y(U)} induced by A -> f^{-1}O_Y(U), and finally the universal property of the sheafification functor; the isomorphism is checked on stalks, where the description of the stalks of the two structure sheaves together with the stalk and localization lemmas for the cotangent complex give the result.
